notes: New printable Conditional Access report: 'Export report' on the tenant CA tab produces a customer-ready document with posture summary, open findings, policy inventory, and backup history.

Conditional Access findings are now deep-linkable end-to-end — fleet rows, stat cards, and inbox incidents land on the exact expanded finding, and drift findings link straight to the latest backup's diff.
Zero Trust coverage on the policy page is judged from what a policy actually does, not its display name — renamed policies keep their coverage mapping.
